controls.name: Independent authority planes
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on every authority-contract or credential-scope change.
controls.release_condition: Separate intake, review, publication, runtime, and release credentials and receipts are deployed and directly observed.

controls.name: Cryptographic chain continuity
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on artifact, prompt, schema, receipt, or canonicalization change.
controls.release_condition: Primary through Master Record release chain validates from exact deployed artifacts and authentic receipts.

controls.name: No implicit authority propagation
controls.freshness_rule: Continuous; fail when any admitted schema or projection grants undeclared authority.
controls.release_condition: Repository validator confirms all security-profile authority booleans remain false.

controls.name: Protected-value non-disclosure
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on every receipt-field, workflow-summary, or public-projection change.
controls.release_condition: Positive and negative runtime fixtures prove protected values never appear in Site, logs, artifacts, or downstream projections.

controls.name: Fail-closed evidence admission
controls.freshness_rule: Run on source/evidence change and through StegVerse-owned runtime observation when live evidence changes.
controls.release_condition: All canonical validators reject missing, stale, simulated, conflicting, or authority-escalating evidence.

controls.name: Dual-control publication and release
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on credential, endpoint, role, or publication-contract change.
controls.release_condition: Deployed publication and Master Record release require distinct authenticated transitions and are observed live.

controls.name: Immutable append-only receipts
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on database migration, receipt schema, or mutation-route change.
controls.release_condition: Write-once and supersession behavior is proven in deployed persistence and restart tests.

controls.name: Software supply-chain provenance
controls.freshness_rule: Required for every production build and dependency update.
controls.release_condition: Production artifacts have locked dependencies, vulnerability results, SBOM, and signed or attestable build provenance.

controls.name: Continuous control observation
controls.freshness_rule: Source/profile changes are validated by the credential-clean dispatcher; post-activation recurrence belongs to the StegVerse-controlled Site #81 observation path, not a GitHub-hosted schedule.
controls.release_condition: Site #81 StegVerse observation produces durable fresh control receipts after production activation while the hosted dispatcher remains non-authorizing source validation only.

controls.name: Recovery without authority inflation
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate for every backup, restore, replay, or disaster-recovery exercise.
controls.release_condition: Recovery exercise proves restored state preserves original authority limits and emits a recovery receipt.

controls.name: Cross-repository least disclosure
controls.freshness_rule: Revalidate on every consumer contract or projection-field change.
controls.release_condition: Every downstream contract has an allowlist and negative fixtures for protected and unnecessary fields.

controls.name: Security regression gate
controls.freshness_rule: Continuous semantics; every relevant source/profile change executes the deterministic validator, and live recurrence is StegVerse-owned.
controls.release_condition: The stable credential-clean validation dispatcher validates the exact profile without secret/token authority, and StegVerse runtime observation preserves fresh live evidence.
